'''Ulaire Cantea Don't Tell Me to Be Quiet, I'll Mine the Heck Outta You!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ulaire Cantea]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed QMC Cantea LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Quiet Mining Colony deck that effectively harnesses the power of QMC and all the destruction it can rain down.

== Strategy ==

The strategy of this deck is similar to all other QMCs. Start Guest quarters, heading, and the efffects listed above. Get out your sites iwth the objective, but make sure that you actually HOLD a site. What i mean is do not leet yourself think that a lone Luke with Lightsbaer will hold a site, nowadays it just won't.  Make sure Pucmir is protected, the extra drain for 1 at each site is very helpful. Using keeping, you should be able to flip really easily.  Also make sure you truly control Bespin, it sucks to lose Falcon with like Han in it against a well timed Zuckuss.  The rest of it is pretty self explanatory.

Emerson "Sparkz" Sklar
Ulaire Cantea

Note: Some of you may have a personal bias against QMC, dont rate it as such.Rate it for the true power of the deck.
